visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a white air fryer where small food items are being arranged on a wire rack inside. The lighting is bright and clean, suggesting a modern kitchen environment. (2) A person's hand holds a large white and red bag of 'Light Calorie Thick Chicken Nuggets' from the brand 'Yuan Flavor.' The text on the bag is clearly visible against a blurred kitchen background. (3) The hand is seen placing individual frozen nuggets onto a piece of parchment paper on a wire rack, carefully spacing them out. The camera is positioned at a top-down angle. (4) The nuggets are shown inside the air fryer, then one is held up with metal tongs, appearing golden brown and crispy. The creator uses scissors to cut it open, revealing a white, meaty interior. (5) Transition to a tray of 'Qian Zhang' dumplings being sprayed with oil from a white bottle. The dumplings have a thin, translucent skin. (6) A woman is seen eating the cooked dumpling with wooden chopsticks, with a blurred tablet in the background showing a different video. (7) The video cuts to various bagels being shown inside the air fryer and then being pulled apart to show fillings like chocolate and green garlic paste. (8) A screen recording of a mobile website shows a list of bagel flavors with prices and 'Add to cart' buttons. (9) Finally, the woman eats a pink rose roselle bagel, showing the cream cheese filling inside while looking directly at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) BGM starts. Upbeat acoustic guitar with a light drum beat. Female voice speaks enthusiastically about 'Original Era' restock group buy. (2) Sound of a plastic bag rustling. Narration introduces the chicken nuggets, highlighting low calorie and high meat content. (3) Tapping sound as nuggets are placed. Narration continues at a fast pace with positive inflection. (4) A series of metallic clicking and snipping sounds occurs as scissors cut through the food. The narrator’s voice rises in pitch to emphasize the texture of the product. (5) A whoosh transition sound effect leads into a description of dumplings. A sharp, high-pitched hiss of an oil spray bottle is clearly audible over the music. (6) A soft crunching sound follows as the creator eats, accompanied by vocal expressions of satisfaction. (7) Digital click sound effects are synchronized with the display of an online ordering screen. (8) As bagels are pulled apart, a tearing sound is heard. The narrator continues her detailed description with high vocal arousal. (9) The video concludes with a direct call to action, the voice remaining authoritative yet welcoming, before the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a group buy for health-conscious food products (low carb nuggets, dumplings, bagels) from the brand 'Yuan Flavor' (原味時代). It uses a relatable, high-energy vlog style to showcase the ease of preparation in an air fryer and the quality of the ingredients.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Creator mentions a restock group buy, shows discount prices on a dedicated ordering page, and provides a clear call to action.
